The device is der Fernseher. Its plural has the same spelling.
Fenster stays Fenster in the plural. Learn das Fenster and die Fenster together.
Tür already has ü. Keep it and add -en: Türen.
Kissen already ends in -en, but das Kissen is singular. The plural noun stays unchanged.
The picture shows a blanket. Decke can also mean the ceiling; context tells you which.
Pflanze → Pflanzen: an -e noun with just -n added.
The noun is das Zuhause. The book's phrase zu Hause means at home. Noun: capital Z; phrase: lower-case zu.
The last part decides: das Geschäft → das Möbelgeschäft. Möbel is plural on its own; the whole shop word is singular.
The last part decides again: das Zimmer → das Hotelzimmer. Its plural spelling stays the same.

meaning: to suppose; to make a guess
